suggested_experiment_name: Lattice QCD axion mass (Borsanyi et al.)
coupling_convention: theta_0 (initial misalignment angle), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: This is a lattice QCD prediction of the dark matter axion mass in the post-inflation scenario, not an experimental exclusion limit on a coupling. The paper predicts m_A = 28(2) ueV strict lower bound, m_A = 50(4) ueV for 50% misalignment contribution, and final estimate m_A = 50-1500 ueV. The x-axis of Fig. 3 is f_A [GeV] (1e9 to 1e19) and y-axis is m_A [ueV]. The relationship is m_A^2 = chi/f_A^2. Emitted points are illustrative of the predicted mass range corresponding to relevant f_A values; these are theoretical predictions not exclusion contours.
